# Callvix Solutions

> Callvix Solutions is a pest control answering service staffed by trained human
> representatives, not an AI voice bot. Representatives answer inbound calls under the
> client's own business name, follow the client's coverage areas, pricing and
> call-handling rules, qualify the pest issue, book eligible appointments and escalate as
> instructed. Callvix works exclusively with pest control companies in the United States.

## Identity
- Callvix Solutions, callvixsolutions.com. A brand of Zenova Trade LLC.
- Business address: 1 Eves Drive, Marlton, NJ 08053, United States. This is a business address, not a walk-in location; representatives answer calls remotely.
- Phone: (551) 373-6777. Email: contact@callvixsolutions.com. Discovery calls are booked via Calendly and last 20 minutes.
- Callvix Solutions is independent of callvix.com and is not affiliated with it.
- The canonical domain is https://callvixsolutions.com (non-www).

## Pricing
- $399/month base, plus $2.99 per inbound call and $0.99 per outbound follow-up call when used. Call length does not change the rate per inbound call; the total still rises with call volume and any add-ons.
- The base covers live answering, qualification and appointment booking by the client's rules, Monday–Friday 9am–6pm in the client's local time, urgent-call triage and escalation during covered hours, and a weekly activity summary.
- Without the CRM Management add-on, booking and call details are shared with the client's team using the method agreed during setup.
- Optional add-ons: After-Hours Coverage $199/month (evenings, during an agreed window; overnight coverage is not offered), Weekend Coverage $149/month (during agreed windows), CRM Management $99/month.
- CRM Management means representatives enter call notes and booking details directly into the client's own CRM using account access the client grants and can revoke. This is manual work by a person, not a native integration, an API connection or automatic data synchronisation, and Callvix has no partnership with any CRM vendor.
- Base and add-ons are billed monthly in advance; call usage is billed weekly. No long-term contract.

## Service
- Industry served: pest control companies, United States only.
- Calls are answered using the client's business name and greeting, following the client's service areas, pricing and booking rules.
- Every call is answered by a trained human representative. Callvix deliberately does not use an AI voice bot on client calls.
- By default representatives do not take payment, quote account balances or process cancellations; those are captured and escalated under the client's instructions. Where a client has explicitly instructed otherwise, that instruction governs.
- Calls that fall outside the client's rules are captured and handed back rather than guessed at.
- Setup: agree the rules, set up call forwarding and any access, run test calls, then coverage starts. Timing depends on the client's phone setup, workflow and approvals.

## Delivery
- Founder-led, with hands-on setup around each client's services, service areas, pricing and booking rules.
- Listed in the DesignRush call center company directory.

## Guides
- [How much does a pest control answering service cost?](https://callvixsolutions.com/blog/pest-control-answering-service-cost): Per-minute and per-call billing, included allowances, base charges and hidden fees, with published pricing from named providers.
- [AI answering service for pest control vs. human](https://callvixsolutions.com/blog/ai-vs-human-answering-service-pest-control): A neutral comparison across cost, coverage hours, urgency, off-script calls, booking and escalation, with five test calls for evaluating both.
- [What missed calls really cost a pest control business](https://callvixsolutions.com/blog/missed-calls-cost-pest-control): A formula for estimating lost revenue from the reader's own booking rate and job value. Contains no industry-average statistic.
- [After-hours pest control call handling](https://callvixsolutions.com/blog/after-hours-pest-control-call-handling): Five coverage decisions, an eligibility gate, four escalation levels, intake fields, a weekend handoff checklist and five test calls.
- [Pest control call script and customer intake form](https://callvixsolutions.com/blog/pest-control-call-script-intake-form): A complete inbound intake script, safety boundary, booking limits, escalation, CRM note template, QA checklist and a printable one-page intake form.
- [Pest control answering service checklist: 25 questions](https://callvixsolutions.com/blog/pest-control-answering-service-checklist): A vendor-neutral checklist covering caller experience, intake, booking rules, escalation, systems access, quality control and pricing, with a 0–10 scorecard and a pilot plan.
- [Free vendor scorecard (PDF)](https://callvixsolutions.com/resources/pest-control-answering-service-vendor-scorecard): An ungated printable scorecard for comparing providers. Direct PDF: https://callvixsolutions.com/assets/pest-control-answering-service-vendor-scorecard.pdf

## Integrations (per-CRM pages)
- [FieldRoutes (PestRoutes)](https://callvixsolutions.com/integrations/fieldroutes): Route density, subscription accounts, lead source attribution and service-area edge cases.
- [PestPac](https://callvixsolutions.com/integrations/pestpac): Service-code mapping, multi-branch and territory rules, warranty and termite/WDO escalation.
- [GorillaDesk](https://callvixsolutions.com/integrations/gorilladesk): Small teams and owner-operators: defined daily booking windows, job durations, tag hygiene.
- [Briostack](https://callvixsolutions.com/integrations/briostack): Recurring-service accounts, conservative booking, cancellation requests recorded and escalated by default.
- [ServiceTitan](https://callvixsolutions.com/integrations/servicetitan): Business units, job types, arrival windows, membership status and campaign attribution.
- [Housecall Pro](https://callvixsolutions.com/integrations/housecall-pro): Not pest-specific software, so pest knowledge comes from the representative; estimates escalated.
